plan: Sell SOXL, SPAL, MUU, and METU to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single name mandate.
Increase QQQI to 15% to favor income and broad market stability.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and reduces overall portfolio risk.
conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for a modest ~1.5% monthly return, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces drawdown risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and concentrating on stable income and broad market exposure. Expect lower volatility but also limited upside potential.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3%, SPAL to 2%, MUU to 3%, and METU to 2% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single name mandate.
Buy ALAB at 4% as a high-scoring scanner setup to add quality tech exposure.
This plan balances risk and growth, maintaining some exposure to high-quality tech.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets approximately ~2.5% monthly growth, prioritizing risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while maintaining exposure to quality tech and broad market indices. Expect moderate volatility and a balanced risk-reward profile.

plan: Add to SOXL to 7%, SPAL to 6%, MUU to 6%, and METU to 6% to increase leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single name mandate.
Add to CRWD to 10% to press a working high-P&L name.
Buy ALAB at 6% as a high-scoring scanner setup to further concentrate in strong tech.
This plan leans into leverage and concentration for aggressive growth.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan aims for a higher ~4% monthly growth, stretching for maximum upside. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring tech setups. Be aware this strategy carries substantially higher drawdown risk, amplified by leverage and daily decay/rebalancing of leveraged ETFs. Strict stop discipline is critical.

plan: Sell SOXL, SPAL, MUU, METU, CRWD, and SNOW to zero to eliminate leveraged ETFs and high-beta single names.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet the single name mandate.
Increase QQQI to 30% to prioritize steady monthly distributions.
This plan focuses on parking cash for yield and low drawdown.
income.read: This income plan targets approximately ~1% monthly yield, prioritizing steady distributions and low drawdown. It significantly reduces exposure to growth-oriented and leveraged assets, focusing on income-generating ETFs and broad market exposure. While aiming for reliable income, distributions are variable, and NAV can still decline in market downturns; this is not a savings account.
